summary.text: Judy Griffin is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly representing District 21, an office she held from 2019 to 2023 and again since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Griffin was born on Long Island, New York.
She received a bachelor's degree in business economics and political science from the State University of New York at Oneonta and a degree from the Institute for Integrative Health.
Her career experience includes working in the financial industry and government, and she also has experience as an integrative health coach, business owner and author.
As of 2025, she was affiliated with the Rockville Centre Newcomers Club, Girl Scouts, the RVC Mercy League, and her local PTA.

For the 2025-2026 session, Griffin was assigned to the Aging; Alcoholism and Drug Abuse; Economic Development, Job Creation, Commerce and Industry; Governmental Employees; Higher Education; and Veterans' Affairs committees.
